Subject: Prop: regional "Lab Day" + dinner co-host (SF)

Hi Evelyn / Marissa,

Hope you both had a great week — quick intro, I’m Leah, head of strategic partnerships at NimbusAI. We’re planning a West Coast series this fall (SF, SEA, and BOS) called the Nimbus Lab Days — half-day hands-on sessions for product/ML/platform engineers followed by a small customer dinner.

High level idea:
- Morning: 3x 30–45m technical sessions (partners + one customer case study)
- Afternoon: hands-on breakouts / workstation demos (capacity ~60)
- Evening: invite-only customer dinner (30 people) for executive networking

We’d love Redwood as a co-host for the SF stop. Benefits for Redwood we’d propose: co-branded microsite, 2 speaking slots (infrastructure + ops use case), shared attendee list for opt-in leads, and a joint blog post after the event.

Attached is a sponsorship matrix (stub) with suggested cost splits and logistics. Can you let us know: 1) interest, 2) availability windows in Sept, and 3) whether Redwood can take the hands-on inference workstation spot?

Thanks — I’m happy to jump on a 20–30m call next week.

Attachments: [Attachment: Nimbus_Sponsorship_Matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Leah Park
Head of Strategic Partnerships | NimbusAI
leah@nimbo.ai | +1 415-555-0124

Subject: Re: Prop: regional "Lab Day" + dinner co-host (SF)

Leah — thanks for the clear note and the deck. We’re interested. Marissa and I chatted — a couple of immediate asks so we can scope: 

1) Agenda adjustments we prefer: 
   - 60m partner deep dive (Redwood + Nimbus) focusing on inference economics and a short live demo of Redwood Dedicated autoscaling
   - 30m customer panel (1–2 customers from each vendor)
   - 90m hands-on breakouts (workstations + guided labs)
2) Attendee caps & ticketing: we need clarity on public vs invite-only buckets (we typically reserve 40 seats for target customers/partners and let 20 open registrations).
3) Budget & cost split: can you confirm line items for venue, F&B, AV, and headcount staffing in the matrix?

We can host the hands-on inference workstation — Karthik will own the lab content and Marcus will coordinate go-to-market + attendee outreach. I’m looping them here.

I attached our Redwood Event Checklist (high level requirements for co-hosted technical events). Next step for us: sync on dates and review a simple MOU that lays out deliverables & lead sharing.

Available for a 20m sync Thurs/Friday this week. Calendly link for my calendar is here: https://calendly.com/redwood-eve/nimbus-labday-availability

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood_Event_Checklist.pdf (application/pdf)]

—

Evelyn / Marissa — great, glad to hear you can co-host. A few quick answers and asks: 

- Dates: potential windows are Sept 14–15, Sept 21–22, or Oct 5 (we prefer Sept).
- Attendee buckets: we’ll do your suggested split (40 reserved / 20 public). We’ll handle public registration and share the opt-in list 5 days after event.
- Budget: I updated the matrix with AV & F&B line items (see v2); suggested split is 60% Nimbus / 40% Redwood for venue & dinner if Redwood co-hosts speaker slots and does promotional lift.

Requests from our side: 
- Co-branded microsite + shared registration form (we can provide templates)
- 1 enterprise case study (slide deck + speaker) from Redwood for the customer panel
- A short joint blog post (500–800 words) published 1–2 weeks post-event

I’ve attached a refreshed sponsorship workbook (v2) with estimated costs and audience demographics. Can Marcus share a short go-to-market timeline for promotion?

Attachments: [Attachment: Nimbus_Sponsorship_Matrix_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Best,
Leah

Leah / team — happy to run the hands-on inference workshop. Quick operational notes from infra/eng: 

- Lab format: 6 workstations with pre-provisioned weights + one live demo cluster for autoscaling tests. We’ll use a hybrid of cloud-hosted GPU instances for scale and local laptops for guided exercises.
- AV / networking: we’ll need wired ethernet for the workstations or a reliable local subnet (no captive portal). Please confirm venue can provide a network closet or VLAN access.
- Time: recommend 90m for labs with 3 parallel tracks (getting started, performance tuning, production rollout patterns).

I can put together the lab repo + step-by-step notebook. I’ll also need a point of contact on the Nimbus side for provisioning demo credentials (short-lived API keys).

—Karthik
